caption:
Most CRMs have stages. Few have exits.

New, Contacted, Quoted, Won: the labels look complete. But nothing tells a lead when it's time to leave a stage, so it sits until someone remembers to check.

Give every stage one exit rule. Write a checkable fact: a text sent, a quote delivered, 48 hours of silence. When that fact turns true, the lead moves.

Open your CRM this week. List every stage. Write the fact that ends it. Assign who or what makes it happen on schedule.

DM TOOLS

#ServiceBusiness #CRM #LeadFollowUp #HomeServices #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels currently lead saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed pipeline-design concept (per-stage exit criteria) distinct from every prior self-score, diagnostic, triage, ladder, ownership, and aging-bucket model already covered.
